sentences.en: One of the first great intellectual feats of a young child is learning how to talk, closely followed by learning how to count.
sentences.zh: 幼儿最伟大的智力成就之一是学习如何说话,紧随其后学习如何计算。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: From earliest childhood we are so bound up with our system of numeration that it is a feat of imagination to consider the problems faced by early humans who had not yet developed this facility.
sentences.zh: 我们从幼年起就与我们的计数系统紧密相连,因此,考虑尚未开发这一设施的早期人类所面临的问题,是想象力的伟大。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构

sentences.en: Careful consideration of our system of numeration leads to the conviction that, rather than being a facility that comes naturally to a person, it is one of the great and remarkable achievements of the human race.
sentences.zh: 仔细考虑我们的计数制度,使人相信,它不是自然地针对一个人的设施,而是人类伟大和显著的成就之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 审议审议情况审议审议

sentences.en: It is impossible to learn the sequence of events that led to our developing the concept of number.
sentences.zh: 无法了解导致我们发展数字概念的事件的顺序。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Even the earliest of tribes had a system of numeration that, if not advanced, was sufficient for the tasks that they had to perform.
sentences.zh: 即使最早的部落也有一套数字系统,如果不能提前确定,就足以完成他们必须完成的任务。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Our ancestors had little use for actual numbers; instead their considerations would have been more of the kind Is this enough?
sentences.zh: 我们的祖先对实际数字没有什么用处;相反,他们的考虑会更像那样,这样还不够吗?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Rather than how many?
sentences.zh: 而不是多少?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: When they were engaged in food gathering, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如,当他们参加食物收集时。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: However, when early humans first began to reflect on the nature of things around them, they discovered that they needed an idea of number simply to keep their thoughts in order.
sentences.zh: 然而,早期人类开始思考周围事物的性质时他们发现他们需要数字的概念来保持思想的秩序

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As they began to settle, grow plants and herd animals, the need for a sophisticated number system became paramount.
sentences.zh: 随着它们开始定居、种植植物和畜牧动物,对一个尖端数字系统的需求变得至关重要。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It will never be known how and when this numeration ability developed, but it is certain that numeration was well developed by the time humans had formed even semi-permanent settlements.
sentences.zh: 永远不知道这种计算能力是如何和何时发展的,但可以肯定,在人类甚至形成半永久性定居点时,数字已经发展得相当完善。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Evidence of early stages of arithmetic and numeration can be readily found.
sentences.zh: 算术和计算早期的证据很容易找到。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The indigenous peoples of Tasmania were only able to count one, two, many; those of South Africa counted one, two, two and one, two twos, two twos and one, and so on.
sentences.zh: 塔斯马尼亚的土著人民只能数到一、二、二、二;南非的土著人民数到一、二、二、二、二、二、一等等。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But in real situations the number and words are often accompanied by gestures to help resolve any confusion.
sentences.zh: 但实际情况中,数字和文字往往伴随着帮助解决任何混乱的姿态。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For example, when using the one, two, many type of system, the word many would mean, Look at my hands and see how many fingers I am showing you.
sentences.zh: 例如,当使用一个,两个,许多类型的系统, 许多人会说, 看看我的手,看看我给你看多少手指。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: This basic approach is limited in the range of numbers that it can express, but this range will generally suffice when dealing with the simpler aspects of human existence.
sentences.zh: 这种基本方法在可以表达的数量范围上是有限的,但在处理人类生存的简单方面时,这一范围一般就足够了。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The lack of ability of some cultures to deal with large numbers is not really surprising.
sentences.zh: 一些文化没有能力处理大量问题,这并不令人感到奇怪。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: European languages, when traced back to their earlier version, are very poor in number words and expressions.
sentences.zh: 欧洲语言在追溯到其早期版本时,其数量和表达方式都非常少。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The ancient Gothic word for ten, tachund, is used to express the number 100 as tachund tachund.
sentences.zh: 古代哥特语的10个,塔昆德语, 用来表达100个,作为塔昆德塔昆德语。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By the seventh century, the word teon had become interchangeable with the tachund or hund of the Anglo-Saxon language, and so 100 was denoted as hund teontig, or ten times ten.
sentences.zh: 到七世纪, 迪昂语已经与盎格鲁-撒克逊语的tachund或hund 互换, 因此100个被形容为 hund teontig, 或十倍十倍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The average person in the seventh century in Europe was not as familiar with numbers as we are today.
sentences.zh: 欧洲七世纪的平均人口不像今天那样熟悉数字

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In fact, to qualify as a witness in a court of law a man had to be able to count to nine!
sentences.zh: 事实上,要有资格成为法院的证人, 男人必须能够数到九!

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 证人证人证人证人证人

sentences.en: Perhaps the most fundamental step in developing a sense of number is not the ability to count, but rather to see that a number is really an abstract idea instead of a simple attachment to a group of particular objects.
sentences.zh: 也许,发展数字感的最根本步骤不是计算能力,而是看到数字实际上是一个抽象的想法,而不是简单地附加于一组特定物体。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It must have been within the grasp of the earliest humans to conceive that four birds are distinct from two birds; however, it is not an elementary step to associate the number 4, as connected with four birds, to the number 4, as connected with four rocks.
sentences.zh: 最早的人类必须能够想象到四只鸟类与两只鸟类不同;然而,将四只鸟类与四只鸟类相连的四只鸟类与四只岩石相连的四只鸟类与四只鸟类联系起来,并不是一个基本步骤。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Associating a number as one of the qualities of a specific object is a great hindrance to the development of a true number sense.
sentences.zh: 将数字作为特定物体的品质之一,是发展真正数字感的巨大障碍。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: When the number 4 can be registered in the mind as a specific word, independent of the object being referenced, the individual is ready to take the first step toward the development of a notational system for numbers and, from there, to arithmetic.
sentences.zh: 当4号可以作为一个具体词在脑中注册时,独立于被引用的对象,个人准备迈出第一步,为数字和从数字到算术开发一个标记系统。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Traces of the very first stages in the development of numeration can be seen in several living languages today.
sentences.zh: 数字开发最初阶段的痕迹,今天可以用几种活语言看到。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The numeration system of the Tsimshian language in British Columbia contains seven distinct sets of words for numbers according to the class of the item being counted: for counting flat objects and animals, for round objects and time, for people, for long objects and trees, for canoes, for measures, and for counting when no particular object is being numerated.
sentences.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省Tsimshian语的计数系统包含七组不同的字,根据所计算的项目类别编号:计算平板物体和动物、圆形物体和时间、人、长形物体和树木、独木舟、计量、计数对象和计数对象。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: It seems that the last is a later development while the first six groups show the relics of an older system.
sentences.zh: 似乎最后一种是后来的发展,而前六组则展示了旧制度的遗迹。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: This diversity of number names can also be found in some widely used languages such as Japanese.
sentences.zh: 数字名称的多样性也出现在日本等一些广泛使用的语言中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Intermixed with the development of a number sense is the development of an ability to count.
sentences.zh: 与若干感的发展相结合的是计算能力的发展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Counting is not directly related to the formation of a number concept because it is possible to count by matching the items being counted against a group of pebbles, grains of corn, or the counter’s fingers.
sentences.zh: 计数与数字概念的形成没有直接关系,因为可以通过将计数项目与一组石块、玉米粒或柜台手指进行比对来进行计算。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: These aids would have been indispensable to very early people who would have found the process impossible without some form of mechanical aid.
sentences.zh: 这些援助对于很早就发现没有某种形式的机械援助不可能进行这一进程的人来说,是必不可少的。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Such aids, while different, are still used even by the most educated in today’s society due to their convenience.
sentences.zh: 此类援助虽然不同,但即使是当今社会中受过最多教育的人也仍然使用,因为方便。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: All counting ultimately involves reference to something other than the things being counted.
sentences.zh: 所有计算最终都涉及提及除计算中的东西以外的其它东西。
